requested_outcome: Repair the complete vacation online-booking family without losing cached capability results or bypassing final live validation.
natural_destination: VII vacation search, last-minute cards, business detail and booking checkout
authorization_boundary: Implement and verify locally as part of the open bug batch. Do not publish until Adir says the batch is complete and authorizes release.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request combines cache, search, detail and checkout behavior into one outcome.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Treat the full path as one contract and do not close on an isolated code fix.

lesson_bundle.reason: A booking regression can appear fixed while one transition still drops the room or online state.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exercise success, stale-cache, supplier failure, loading, retry and final validation boundaries.

lesson_bundle.reason: Undated online filtering must be immediate and cache-backed while dated search remains authoritative.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Separate cached capability discovery from dated live availability and prove both paths.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Online places disappear when a scheduled refresh is late or the supplier has a transient failure.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep the last accepted capability snapshot and refresh it in the background every thirty minutes.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Stale accepted data still filters and orders online places while checkout revalidates live.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The card says online but the business or checkout page cannot identify the selected room.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Carry the supplier room ID through card, detail, quote and checkout.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The exact room ID survives every transition and is verified against the published room catalog.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A non-authoritative calendar dependency blocks a bookable room.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use the official vacancy endpoint as the authoritative pre-booking check and use search only to choose a room when none was supplied.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A known room reaches vacancy directly and an unknown room uses search then vacancy.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A status message promises online booking while no working call to action exists.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Derive the action from the verified quote and keep informational deal copy neutral.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No copy claims an online continuation independently of the booking-ready state.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After reproducing the live failure and tracing the room from card to quote.
checks: Confirm whether stale cache status suppresses accepted online evidence.
Confirm whether the room ID is lost before the authoritative vacancy check.

attack_questions: Does a stale accepted cache still return real online places?
Can a transient capability refresh erase the last known list?
Can a card lose its room ID before checkout?
Can checkout proceed without a live authoritative vacancy and price response?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Local release candidate exercised across search, detail and checkout, followed by production evidence only after release authorization.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Targeted automated tests, type checking, build and responsive browser checks for the full online-booking path.

effectiveness.baseline: The live system exposed cached online places but suppressed them when stale, dropped the room ID on navigation and returned supplier_unavailable from the stay-quote path.
effectiveness.target: A single coherent booking path with instant undated discovery, exact room continuity and authoritative live validation before checkout.
